params.body:
## What was wrong

The transport request modal shows a field for every dimension the vehicle lacks, also when it reopens an open request (the truck on the transport overview, or "back" in the modal). That form posts the request's `uuid`, and `TransportService::store` only handled dimensions on the path without a `uuid`. On a change of an open request the typed width, height and length were dropped: the vehicle kept 0, the request kept NULL in its dimension columns, the class stayed "in aanvraag" and the confirmation showed "0 mm". The controller's R S4-10.1 check did count the typed values, so the request went through as if it were complete.

Seen on a local demo instance, where the seeded transport is written without dimensions.

## What changes

- `TransportService::store` writes typed dimensions onto a vehicle without them on both paths (R S4-10.4, unchanged rule: never overwrite existing dimensions).
- An open request without dimensions takes the vehicle's on a change, so class and price are computed on them. A request that already carries dimensions keeps them.
- R S4-10.4 in `14-s4-verkopen-aan-een-klant.md` says so; new finding `bevinding: transport-wijziging-vergat-de-afmetingen` (opgelost).

## Delivery address: no behaviour change

R S4-10.3 states that the delivery address must be one of the dealer's own locations with the delivery flag (validated), and the code does exactly that, so for a vehicle sold to a customer pick-up and delivery are both at the dealer unless he has a separate delivery location. The S4-10 introduction speaks of delivering "bij een klant", and the demo dataset writes a transport to a customer address directly into the table, which the form cannot do. That tension is recorded as `open punt: transport-leveradres-enkel-eigen-locaties` rather than changed here.

## Tests

- `test_dimensions_typed_in_a_new_request_are_stored_on_the_request_and_shown_in_the_confirmation`
- `test_dimensions_typed_when_changing_an_open_request_are_stored_on_the_request_and_the_vehicle` (fails on main: dimensions stay 0)
- `test_changing_an_open_request_keeps_the_dimensions_it_already_has`

Local: full suite 2362 tests green, Rules* and QualityRatchetTest green, PHPStan no errors.
params.title: A transport request keeps the dimensions typed when it is changed
